The '''Ebe Crater quarry''' was a quarry located in the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] [[Ebe Crater Valley/Legends|Ebe Crater Valley]].<ref name="Inside" /> By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}}, as depicted in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> the thick adobe walls of the [[Skywalker home/Legends|Skywalker home]] in [[Slave Quarters Row/Legends|Slave Quarters Row]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on Tatooine had an infill of [[Stone/Legends|stone]] [[Mining/Legends|mined]] locally from the quarry.<ref name="Inside" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ebe Crater quarry was first mentioned in the [[2000]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', which was written by [[Kristin Lund]].<ref name="Inside" />
